question: On ESP32 chip revision v3.1, can GPIO4 use a rising-edge interrupt while other GPIO0-31 pins also have interrupts enabled? If not, what level-triggered workaround does the errata describe?

content.text: Question: On ESP32 chip revision v3.1, can GPIO4 use a rising-edge interrupt while other GPIO0-31 pins also have interrupts enabled? If not, what level-triggered workaround does the errata describe?

generation.answer: On ESP32 chip revision v3.1, GPIO4 cannot use a rising-edge interrupt while other GPIO0-31 pins also have interrupts enabled due to the limitation described in [Page 1]. The errata describes a workaround: set the GPIO interrupt type to high after the CPU services the interrupt, then change it to low for a second interrupt that occurs at this time, which the CPU needs to ignore.
